---
title: "Machine Learning"
toc: false
---

Three group case studies from CSE 450, each built in Python for a different kind of prediction problem.

- [Bank Telemarketing Targeting](Machine_Learning/bank-telemarketing.qmd): A decision tree that finds the customers most likely to respond to a bank campaign.
- [King County Housing Prices](Machine_Learning/housing-prices.qmd): An XGBoost model that predicts home prices with an R² of 0.898.
- [Bike Rental Demand](Machine_Learning/bike-demand.qmd): A neural network that forecasts holiday bike rentals with an R² of 0.951.
